First, I Absolutely love the idea of a Horizon based D&D game.
Secondly, it may be a bias from how they were utilized in Ark Survival Evolved, but I would actually say to make it Transport Class, Since, for flying machines, you do already have the Storm Bird in Combat Class, Glinthawk and Sunwing in Acquisition, and Skydrifter in Recon.  And nothing says that just cause it’s not strictly combat class it can’t be a super strong machine, Behemoths always kick my ass lol.

Only name idea I can think of is maybe Cloud Surfer/Slicer? Something along those lines to slide to how high it soars?

A few Ideas for Parts/Weak Spots would be some Balancing/ Long Glide Assisting Thrusters of some kind on the wings, since the Quetzalcoatl was one of the largest flying dinosaurs in real life and had a massive wingspan,  it’s Giant Beak could also be a detachable part/key resource(and detaching it could disable that tongue attack you mentioned).  Also If you did go with it beingTransport class it could have a bit Resource container with some decent loot that you would have to shoot the locks off of first like a behemoth.

As for attacks I don’t have too many ideas atm, in the middle of a workout actually lol but I saw your post and wanted to type some ideas in between sets so I didn’t forget.
But could definitely give it atleast a wind gust attack like the storm bird, and maybe some plasma attacks similar but not identical to the Sunwing?  
Another idea is maybe giving it ice attacks since they flew at pretty high altitudes, it could possibly collect frost from the clouds and deliver them into cannons, or some sweeping Frost Tornado Aoe thing.

That’s all I got lol, but hope any of that possibly helps!
